title: Japko PVP+
description: High-performance PvP resource pack designed to boost FPS and reduce lag while keeping a clean look.
body: Performance PvP PackThis resource pack is designed for players who need maximum performance during combat. It simplifies textures to reduce lag and increase FPS, providing a smooth and competitive experience.Features🚀 Extreme Optimization: Lightweight textures for the best possible frame rates.⚔️ PvP Focused: Clean visuals to help you focus on the fight.📦 Enhanced UI: Transparent and clean inventory for better battlefield awareness.CreditsSpecial thanks to CapTommy!for inventory/UI textures in this pack are based on / taken from the CapTommy Resource Pack. All credit for those specific assets goes to the original creator.Make sure to move this pack to the top of your Resource Packs list in Minecraft settings!
